verdicts.reason: Candle.binary_inference_rule in HolSoundness.lean omits the entire antecedent of HOL4's binary_inference_rule (that q is Bool-typed and term_ok, semantically implied by p1 and p2 in every structure, and that h1, h2 entail p1, p2). Concluding entails0 mem (thy, term_union h1 h2) q unconditionally is strictly stronger and false (e.g., for q = Var x (Tyvar x)), a clear V-P violation.
